genomic BLUP selection is more effective than genealogical BLUP selection in maintaining genetic diversity, and that the coancestry measure based on shared segments is the best performing method.
genomic selection methods are superior in terms of genetic gain and diversity maintained compared with genealogical-based methods.

the use of genomic selection in a BLUP framework is a very promising approach that can be implemented in the short term, and it is not only a matter of having more and more markers.

, in terms of co-ancestry and diversity, the use of genomic information is superior to the genealogical information, but the use of the genomic-based coancestries can have similar effects on genetic gain.
